model: all inverse LUT angular roots at each predicted component XY; equally weighted wrapped Gaussian angular pseudo-observation; latent angular sigma IMM
angular_likelihood: sum_m WN(wrap(psi-g_m(x,y,s)); sigma_j^2)/M; position dependence linearized using -dg/dxy = h_xy/h_psi; marginalize conditional position uncertainty and winding images

approximation: inverse angles depend on estimated XY; equal-root normalized pseudo-likelihood is NOT exact change of variable of original s likelihood; no independent angle sensor claim; no uncertainty calibration claim
windings: each prior and observation winding evaluated separately with9sigma support
data: same R2 AnchorB mount0 seed0; LOS/Full x4bias; 979 causal samples, score829 at t>=30
gate: matched: original S4 causal mask; same gate for v3 comparison; no independent new gate performance claim
parameters: frozen before evaluation; no GT fitting
